integrity: The counterexample is proved by two independent arguments: a degree/homotopy obstruction and direct noninjectivity of the displayed interpolation for the circle reflection.
scientific_limitations: The result refutes Theorem 4.9 as stated on the circle and identifies a gap in the proof route to Theorem E. It does not claim that Theorem E itself is false, and it does not exclude a corrected orientation-compatible perturbation lemma.
title: Orientation obstruction to a fixed-ball perturbation lemma
